끝에 큰 물방울이 달린 짙은 청록색 꼬리
visual_en: A small 2-head tall creature facing right, featuring a deep teal translucent body and flowing dark purple liquid hair. A bright lime-green glowing orb floats above its head. The creature has glowing lime-green eyes and a thick dark teal tail ending in a large, heavy water droplet. A simple white band with purple patterns wraps around its torso. Tiny air bubbles are visible within its teal skin, and small lime-green sparkles drift from the tail's tip.
features_en: Thick dark teal tail with large droplet
pose_en: Floating calmly while emitting a soft pulse.
vfx_en: Expanding concentric ripples of lime-green light.
lore: 플레이어와 거리를 두고, 2.2초마다 주변 몹을 치유한다.
